rationale: A unanimous, narrow accrual/limitations holding with strong workability and comity themes makes the Chief Justice the modal assignee/author, with Justice Kagan the leading alternative given her central role in framing the “as construed”/finality rationale. Any separate writing is most likely a short concurrence (Thomas/Alito/Gorsuch) emphasizing general accrual principles and limiting the decision to Skinner/Chapter 64-style procedural challenges.
